templates.name: Movie reference
templates.noteNameFormat: {{"the title of the film the note is about, exactly as the note writes it. Leave empty if the note doesn't name a film"}}

properties.name: title
properties.value: {{"the title of the film the note is about, exactly as the note writes it. Leave empty if the note doesn't name a film"}}

properties.name: director
properties.value: {{"the film's director or directors, separated by a comma and a space, only if the note names them. Otherwise leave empty, and never guess"|split:", "|wikilink|join:", "}}

properties.name: cast
properties.value: {{"the actors the note mentions, separated by a comma and a space. Leave empty if it mentions none, and never add actors the note doesn't name"|split:", "|wikilink|join:", "}}

properties.name: genre
properties.value: {{"the film's genres, separated by a comma and a space, only if the note states them. Otherwise leave empty"}}

properties.name: year
properties.value: {{"the year the film was released, as four digits, only if the note states it. Otherwise leave empty, and never guess"}}
